summary: Nordicus Partners filed an 8-K reporting a September 10, 2026 financing: a $600,000 Convertible Grid Promissory Note issued to Keystone Capital Partners LLC for $500,000 cash, plus 250,000 commitment shares. The note carries 5.0% interest, matures June 10, 2027, and is convertible only upon and during an Event of Default and only after maturity, at 90% of the trailing 10-day VWAP. Prepayment runs at a 120% premium; a resale registration statement is due by November 1, 2026. This is a routine private financing, not a special situation.
